title: Perficient is excluded as a non-EU enterprise consultancy on the Flowable partner list
content:
Perficient's entry in the Flowable Partner Finder describes a global digital consultancy based in St. Louis, and the flag pairs two grounds for exclusion: non-EU and enterprise. Nothing engine-specific was found against it.

The row illustrates how the sweep triaged. Where geography and scale both apply, the research stopped at the card rather than resolving verticals, allegiance or delivery depth — the entry was mined on 2026-08-18 and never imprint-swept. That keeps the cost of screening a 200-plus-entry directory proportionate, at the price of a record that supports no judgement beyond the exclusion itself.

Kept as a registry entry, its value is negative evidence: it documents that a firm of this profile was seen and set aside deliberately, so it does not resurface as an unexplored lead.
